entries.journey.intro: Each story follows its own trail, with new glades and familiar guests.
entries.journey.empty: New stories are still being prepared. For now, continue along the main trail.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.1: Anna's familiar bag rests by the path. Its patch is the same one you saw at the forest camp.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.2: Fresh footprints mark the old boards. Someone kept bringing belongings here even after the pier stopped welcoming boats.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.3: Inside the dry tent, Anna unfolds plans of the tower. Her grandfather once tended its light, but his last notes end abruptly.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.4: An empty shelf is visible through the tower window. It once held a lantern; a hook for a familiar scarf still hangs beside it.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.5: The letter does not say where the keeper went. It asks only that a light be left for those returning late.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.6: Bohdan recognizes the scarf: a visitor at the old station wore it in winter. How it reached this place remains unknown.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.7: The guests bring the last boards and clean the glass. They are no longer waiting to be rescued; they are making a place to meet.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.8: The tower shines over your camp again. Two cups wait on the bench. One signature in the letter is still unreadable: this place has its ending, but its people's story continues.

entries.journey.title: Story trails
entries.journey.main.title: The shelter trail
entries.journey.main.description: The main story across 42 glades. First safe camps — then places joining into a living network.
entries.journey.lighthouse.title: Light of the old lighthouse
entries.journey.lighthouse.description: Salt wind, an old pier and a tower that will shine again. A standalone story with your own evening camp.
entries.journey.garden.title: A garden after winter
entries.journey.garden.description: An abandoned greenhouse, a seed box and the first flowers. This journey is still in preparation.
entries.journey.station.title: Autumn at the old station
entries.journey.station.description: Rain on the canopy, golden leaves and a place for a new meeting. This journey is still in preparation.

entries.journey.memories.title: Roadside Memories
entries.journey.memories.description: Three glades about places you already made safe. A free story — unlocked by playing.
entries.journey.memories.story.1: Anna recognized the path — this is where you pitched your first tent. She returned because the place stayed safe.
entries.journey.memories.story.2: Distant fires glow at the forest edge. Bohdan counts them aloud — each fire is a place you once opened.
entries.journey.memories.story.3: The old camp post still stands. Fresh marks on it — strangers have flagged this spot as a reliable shelter.
entries.journey.main.story.31: The old crossing creaks underfoot — the road between your camps is walkable again.
entries.journey.main.story.32: Someone left a lantern on the bridge rail. Anna says it lit the way for the last travellers, years ago.
entries.journey.main.story.33: Bohdan recognizes the spot where he once waited for his boat. Now it sleeps travellers under a roof of branches.
entries.journey.main.story.34: Beyond the bridge lies a glade you settled earlier. People have started asking the way to it again.
entries.journey.main.story.35: The old station platform is swept after years of silence. The timetable matters to no one yet — but warmth has returned.
entries.journey.main.story.36: The former farm smells of hay. Someone put it back in order — and passers-by have a place to rest again.
entries.journey.main.story.37: Names of guests are carved into the station wall. Among them are people who slept in your very first camps.
entries.journey.main.story.38: The evening train no longer stops here, but the bench under the canopy is never empty now.
entries.journey.main.story.39: The shore of an abandoned settlement smells of salt and smoke. Boats have not landed for years — your fires are visible from the water.
entries.journey.main.story.40: Waves wash the old pier. Your glade is the one place people still return to here.
entries.journey.main.story.41: The half-ruined house by the shore is smoking again — a neighbour has appeared nearby.
entries.journey.main.story.42: The road from your first glade to this shore is open now. The network of places is alive — people are coming back.
entries.district.glades.title: First Glades
entries.district.glades.intro: Your first glades. Place tents so every guest keeps a path to their door — that is the foundation of everything.
entries.district.forest.title: The Forest Path
entries.district.forest.intro: Deeper forest glades. Same rules, new places — watch the signs near fires and shade.
entries.district.embers.title: Someone's Fires
entries.district.embers.intro: Camps with fires and shade lie ahead. You already know how to make places safe — now make them feel like home.
entries.district.bridges.title: Old Bridges
entries.district.bridges.intro: Thirty glades behind you. Now those places begin to connect — the old bridges carry the road between camps again.
entries.district.stations.title: Stations and Farms
entries.district.stations.intro: Next come stations and farms where people once lived. Your camps make these places work again.
entries.district.shores.title: Shores and Settlements
entries.district.shores.intro: The last stretch — abandoned settlements on the shores. Settle them, and the network of places is complete.
entries.map.bonus.frost.title: The Frost Glade
entries.map.bonus.frost.description: First snow on the pines and a quiet place waiting for a winter evening. Only opens in winter.

entries.privacy.explanation: If you choose, we can learn which clearings are difficult, when hints help and whether the game runs smoothly. Our events contain only counts and ranges, without names, touch coordinates, advertising IDs or saved layouts. Declining does not limit play.
entries.privacy.provider: Processed by Google Analytics for Firebase. After consent the SDK also uses a pseudonymous installation ID and standard technical data. See the privacy policy for details.

entries.privacy.cleared: Collection is off and local analytics is cleared. Progress is kept. Previously uploaded data needs a separate deletion request.

entries.legal.localExplanation: Progress, tent layouts, your album and settings are saved on your device.
entries.legal.noAccount: This version does not use accounts or cloud saves.
entries.legal.localClearHelp: Withdraws consent and clears local analytics data. Your game progress stays.
entries.legal.serverDeleteHelp: Previously sent data requires a separate request. Clearing your device does not delete it from the server.
entries.legal.unavailable: Documents and contact details have not been published yet. Unavailable links are disabled.
entries.legal.credits: Vegetation and base UI elements: Kenney, CC0. Font: DejaVu Sans; its license is included below.
entries.legal.dataInformation.local: The game keeps progress, tents, your album, cosmetics and settings until you clear them. Resetting progress retains cosmetics and settings; erasing game data removes those too.
entries.legal.dataInformation.optional: Analytics requires a separate choice. Declining does not restrict play. Collection is inactive without a provider. Advertising privacy is managed separately.
entries.legal.dataInformation.backups: Erasing covers the game save and its local recovery copies. It does not delete operating-system backups, advertising SDK data or records already sent to servers.
entries.legal.dataInformation.requests: For previously sent data, use the published request page. Opening a page does not submit a request or confirm deletion.
entries.legal.erase: Erase game data on this device
entries.legal.erase.confirm: Delete progress, tents, your album, cosmetics and settings? They cannot be recovered in the game. Analytics consent will be withdrawn.
entries.legal.erase.scope: This erases the local game save and its recovery copies. Server records and operating-system backups need separate controls.
entries.legal.erase.failed: Some data could not be erased. Retry or clear the app data in your device settings.
entries.legal.erase.menuOnly: You can clear saved progress from the main menu.
